Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Richmond hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 15 Richmond hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 4, Traveluro at 2, Vio.com at 2, Evendo at 1, Kiwi.com at 1 and the hotel's own site at 1. These are the Richmond rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Richmond hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 16% ($18 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 16% at Holiday Inn Express Richmond - Midtown by IHG to 17% at Best Western Plus Executive Hotel. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
